items.exampleEn: There is a reason for everything.
Our English teacher is very nice.
items.exampleZh: 我們的英文老師人很好。

items.exampleEn: My brother goes to college in Taipei.
items.exampleZh: 我的兄弟在台北讀大學。

items.exampleEn: I am taking a cooking course.
We have English class at nine.
Write your answer on this paper.

items.sentenceZh: 我們的老師教我們歷史。

items.audioEn: I am not in class today because I am sick.
items.audioZh: 我今天沒去上課，因為我生病了。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼沒去上課？

items.sentenceEn: The teacher gives us our test results.
items.sentenceZh: 老師把考試結果發給我們。

items.stemZh: 我的姊妹在大學念藝術。

items.stemEn: Mr. Lin ____ English at our school.
items.stemZh: 林先生在我們學校教英文。

items.passageEn: Ben is a college student. This year, he is taking a computer course. His teacher is very good, and she uses many examples in class. Ben's test result is great. The reason is that he studies every night.
items.passageZh: Ben 是大學生。今年他在上一門電腦課程。他的老師很好，上課時會舉很多例子。Ben 的考試成績很棒，原因是他每天晚上都讀書。

questions.questionZh: Ben 考試成績好的原因是什麼？

items.promptZh: 請把你的名字寫在這張紙上。
referenceEn: Please write your name on this paper.
Please write your name on this piece of paper.
rubricZh: 「在紙上」用 on（例如 on this paper、on this piece of paper）
please 放句首或句尾都可以

referenceEn: Who taught you to play the piano?
rubricZh: teach 後面接人和要教的內容（例如 taught you to play the piano）
